thread:
alex: kicking off a config-only deploy for sidecar routing weight and batching. canary at 5%. change window 12:00-13:00 PT.

deploy-bot: kickoff ok  canary job id c-20260321-02  targets: service=sidecar env=prod-canary  config: routing.weight=0.05, batch.max_tokens=2048, timeout.ms=60000

meera: are we pinning model for the canary?

alex: yes pin to model v2.4.1. fallback to v2.3.9 allowed only on capacity errors.

juan: watching kvcache hit rate and p95 decode. abort criteria: p95 > 300ms or error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 3m.

sam-sre: added prometheus alert: sidecar_p95_latency_ms > 300 for 3m AND sidecar_error_rate > 0.5%

olivia: will post a small release blurb in #product after canary passes.

meera: opinion on kvcache pressure? Rollback first then tune batch?

alex: rollback first. rollback plan: `/deploy config revert c-20260321-02 --reason=canary-failure` and revert routing.weight to 0.02, disable batching tweak.

deploy-bot: canary c-20260321-02: 5% live, started 12:05 PT. health checks active. next summary at 12:20 PT.

juan: canary shard a p95 ~ 295ms and climbing. kv miss rate 11%. still below thresholds.

sam-sre: memory on canary pods +8% but not OOM.

alex: hold at 5% for another 15m. do not ramp.

meera: updating release note draft: [config-only] sidecar routing weight -> 5%; batch.max_tokens 2048; pinned model v2.4.1. Monitoring p95 and kv miss.

12:20 PT deploy-bot: canary health summary: p95=302ms (3m avg), error_rate=0.12%  ALERT triggered.

sam-sre: alert fired; initiating rollback per plan.

jun: executing rollback now. running `/deploy config revert c-20260321-02`

deploy-bot: rollback complete. config restored: routing.weight=0.02; batch.max_tokens=1024; timeout.ms=45000

alex: thanks all. I'll reopen a follow-up ticket to iterate on batching strategy and kvcache warming. assign to eng-runtime.

olivia: updated product blurb with rollback note.

meera: note for postmortem: consider staged kvcache prewarm step before changing batch size in prod.

juan: logs attached (snippet):
```
[12:18:20] sidecar-canary-a decode p95=310ms kv_miss=13% connections=120
[12:18:40] sidecar-canary-a decode p95=320ms kv_miss=15% connections=125
```

sam-sre: closing the canary ticket, moving to follow-up.

alex: great coordination.
